concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-onboard-users-terms-of-service]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace custom-onboarding Terms of Service guide for requirement webhook, type lookup, document presentation, authorized individual acceptance and TEST/LIVE type distinction.
warnings: A generated or presented document is not acceptance; the PATCH must identify the main legal entity, generated document ID and individual legal entity that accepted.
The TEST `adyenForPlatformsAdvanced` type is default test configuration and does not establish the type required in LIVE or completion of KYC/capability verification.
